title: AI agent: latency, tokens and cost from @ai-sdk/otel
description: gen_ai.client.inference.duration from @ai-sdk/otel, plus token usage and list-price cost, for two AI SDK services: an on-call agent on two models, and a fix explainer for react-inp-blame on its live demo.

list.name: Model call failed, not the deadline

options.content:
### Two AI SDK services, measured with the AI SDK's own OpenTelemetry metric
A small on-call helper agent built on the [AI SDK](https://ai-sdk.dev) answers questions about a shop with two tools. It runs around the clock on two models through the Gemini API free tier: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and the open-weights Gemma 4 26B. Latency comes from `gen_ai.client.inference.duration`, the histogram [@ai-sdk/otel](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ai-sdk/otel) records for every model call. I asked for it in [vercel/ai#24229](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/24229) and it shipped in @ai-sdk/otel 1.0.160. Tokens come from the semconv `gen_ai.client.token.usage` histogram. Cost is tokens times each model's list price, so it shows what this traffic would cost on the paid tier. Gemma has no paid price, so its cost is zero. Prices as of November 3, 2026. Further down, the second service runs a real workload: a fix explainer for my react-inp-blame library, on its live demo.

panels.title: The on-call agent, right now
Runs finished, last 15 minutes
panels.description: Zero means the agent has stopped. Every model runs its own loop, so a stuck model shows up here.

panels.title: Task checks passed, last hour
panels.description: Did it do what it was asked: called the tools the question needs, answered, and named what was asked about. All three checks on every finished run.

panels.title: p95 model call, last hour
panels.description: 95th percentile of gen_ai.client.inference.duration over the last hour, all models.

panels.title: Calls that failed, last hour
panels.description: Share of model calls the histogram recorded with error.type set. Most are the 1.5 second deadline one run in ten gets on purpose.

panels.title: Spend per month at this pace
panels.description: Last hour of tokens at list price, times 24 times 30. Budget $30 a month. Gemma 4 26B has no paid price on the Gemini API, so it adds nothing.

targets.expr:
sum(sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[1h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[1h])) * 2.5e-06)
)) * 24 * 30

panels.title: Which model does the job
Both models, last 6 hours
panels.description: The same questions go to both models all day. Read across a row to pick a model for this job: speed, whether it does what it was asked, and what it costs at list price.

targets.expr:
((sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[6h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[6h])) * 2.5e-06)
)) or (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(agent_runs_total[6h])) * 0)) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(agent_runs_total[6h])) * 1000

panels.title: A real workload: the fix explainer for react-inp-blame

options.content: [react-inp-blame](https://github.com/adityareddy-dev/react-inp-blame) is my library that says which React component made a click slow. Here a headless Chrome opens its live demo at [reactinpblame.com](https://reactinpblame.com), makes one of the demo's slow interactions, and reads the report the library writes. A model on the AI SDK (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, Gemini API free tier) gets that report, reads the component's source with one tool, and says why the interaction was slow and what to change. Every answer is checked against the library's own blame and against the fix the demo documents, which the model never sees. Same instrumentation as the agent above: `gen_ai.client.inference.duration` from @ai-sdk/otel, token usage, and spans through the Collector.

panels.title: Explanations, last hour
panels.description: Interactions measured on the live demo and explained. Zero means it stopped.

panels.title: Named the component the library blamed, last 6 hours
panels.description: The answer names the component, handler or child react-inp-blame put the time on.

panels.title: Gave the fix the demo documents, last 6 hours
panels.description: The answer proposes the fix the demo's lab page lists for that interaction (useMemo, virtualise, move state down, a worker, and so on). The model never sees that page.

panels.title: p95 model call, last hour
panels.description: gen_ai.client.inference.duration from @ai-sdk/otel, for the explainer only.

panels.title: p95 to explain one interaction, last hour
panels.description: From the explain_interaction span: measuring the click in Chrome, reading the source and writing the answer.

panels.title: Each slow interaction on the live demo, last 6 hours
panels.description: One row per interaction in the demo's anti-pattern lab. Read across: how slow the click really was, how long the explanation took, and whether it got the cause and the fix right.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent_task) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="react-inp-blame-explainer", span_name="explain_interaction", agent_outcome="ok"}[6h])))

Tokens per minute, input and output
panels.description: From gen_ai.client.token.usage, recorded once per model call.

targets.expr:
sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[1h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[1h])) * 2.5e-06)
)

panels.title: Tokens per model call (average)
panels.description: Tool results make input grow with each step of a run.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_token_type) (rate(gen_ai_client_token_usage_count{service_name="oncall-agent"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cost per agent run
panels.description: One-hour cost divided by runs finished in that hour.

targets.expr:
sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[1h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[1h])) * 2.5e-06)
) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(agent_runs_total[1h]))

panels.title: Doing what it was asked, within budget
Runs that passed each check
panels.description: Rolling one hour. used_required_tools: the run called every tool its question needs. answered: the reply is not empty. on_topic: the reply names what was asked about.

panels.title: Required tools used, by model and task
panels.description: Rolling six hours. Shows which model skips a tool on which kind of question.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_request_model, agent_task) (increase(agent_task_checks_total{check="used_required_tools", result="pass"}[6h])) / sum by (gen_ai_request_model, agent_task) (increase(agent_task_checks_total{check="used_required_tools"}[6h]))

panels.title: Spend in the last 24 hours, share of daily budget
panels.description: Last 24 hours of tokens at list price against a $1.00 daily budget.

targets.expr:
sum(sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[24h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[24h])) * 2.5e-06)
)) / 1.0

panels.title: Cost per 1,000 runs, last 6 hours
panels.description: Both models together at list price. Gemma 4 26B runs count, its cost is zero.

targets.expr:
sum(sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="input"}[6h])) * 3e-07)
  or
  (sum by (gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{service_name="oncall-agent", gen_ai_request_model="gemini-3.5-flash-lite", gen_ai_token_type="output"}[6h])) * 2.5e-06)
)) / sum(increase(agent_runs_total[6h])) * 1000

Runs that failed a check, by check and model
panels.description: Counted from the oncall_question spans in 5 minute steps. agent.checks.failed lists every check a run failed, so a run that skipped its tool and also left out the service shows as both.

targets.query: { name = "oncall_question" && span.agent.checks.failed != nil } | count_over_time() by (span.agent.checks.failed, span.gen_ai.request.model)
